description: Replace a time range on one axis with a described motion (sections, the same as play_motion) or with exact points. With sections the motion starts at from_ms and replaces what was there until it ends. With actions the points keep their own times, or are moved so the first one lands on from_ms. The motion is fitted to 400 units per second like the Speed Limiter unless fit_to_device_speed is false. Lands in the editor at once as one Undo step. To add, move or delete single points without replacing a range, use edit_points.

Section.description:
One stretch of motion. Fields ending in _end ramp linearly from the
section's start value to that value by the section's end.

bottom.description: Lowest position of each stroke (0 = bottom of travel).
bottom.title: Bottom

bottom_end.description: Lowest position at the section end.
bottom_end.title: Bottom End

curve.description: Stroke shape: snap (linear, crisp), ease (smooth), settle (lingers low), hold-peak (pauses briefly at the top), rise (slow rise, quick drop).
curve.title: Curve

duration_seconds.description: Length of this section in seconds.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

kind.description: strokes = repeated up-down strokes; hold = stay still at one position.
kind.title: Kind

position.description: Hold sections only: the position to hold. Omit to hold where the motion stopped.
position.title: Position

strokes_per_minute.description: Tempo at the section start. One stroke is a full down-up-down cycle. Slow 20-40, medium 50-90, fast 100-160, very fast 170+.
strokes_per_minute.title: Strokes Per Minute

strokes_per_minute_end.description: Tempo at the section end, to speed up or slow down gradually.
strokes_per_minute_end.title: Strokes Per Minute End

top.description: Highest position of each stroke (100 = top of travel).
top.title: Top

top_end.description: Highest position at the section end.
top_end.title: Top End

variation.description: Random variation in tempo and depth for a less mechanical feel. 0 = exact, 0.2-0.4 = natural.
variation.title: Variation

Section.title: Section

axis.description: Axis. stroke is the main up and down axis.
axis.title: Axis

editor_code.description: The editor code the user reads from the editor's AI panel under Your own AI, for example K7P4QX. Leave it out when connected with the account address.
editor_code.title: Editor Code

from_ms.description: Start of the time range in milliseconds on the video timeline.
from_ms.title: From Ms
